title: A complex relationship
goal: I can sum up the relationship between the United States and Latin America with argument markers.
grammar: markers for building and closing an argument

items: I can open an argument with *en primer lugar*.
I can add a point with *además*.
I can name examples of migration and cultural exchange.
I can build and close an argument with *en primer lugar*, *además* and *en resumen*.
I can give examples of migration between Latin America and the United States.
I can give examples of cultural exchange.
I can say what happened to the Panama Canal in 1999.
I can say what historians discuss about this relationship.
